sn2.9:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Candimā devaputto Rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti ||
sn2.9:1.3: Atha kho Candimā devaputto Bhagavantam anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || 2.
sn2.9:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Candimaṃ devaputtam ārabbha Rāhum asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn2.9:5.1: Atha kho Rāhu asurindo Candimaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena Vepacitti asurindo ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.9:5.2: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Rāhum asurindaṃ Vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || 5.
